text: To run this repository's tests, use `uv run pytest` from the repository root; plain `pytest` misses the src layout and fails with ImportError.
The payments service listens on port 8443 and only accepts TLS connections; health checks go to /healthz on the same port.
Database migrations live in db/migrations and are applied with `make migrate`; never edit a migration that has already shipped.
When the build fails with 'node: not found' in CI, the job image is missing Node; switch the job to the ci-node20 image instead of installing Node in the script.
The user prefers answers in Chinese with code identifiers left in English, and wants a short summary before details.
Feature flags are read from config/flags.yaml at startup; changing a flag requires a restart of the API pods.
Flaky test test_upload_timeout passes when run alone; it fails under parallel runs because it shares the /tmp/uploads directory. Use a per-test temp dir.
Release tags follow vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and are created only from the main branch by the release workflow.
To rotate the API signing key, generate a new key, add it as the secondary key, deploy, then promote it to primary after 24 hours.
The nightly job exports usage reports to the bucket reports-prod under the prefix usage/YYYY/MM/DD/.
A memory leak in the worker was traced to an unbounded LRU cache in parse_template; capping it at 1024 entries fixed it.
The staging environment resets its database every Sunday at 03:00 UTC from an anonymized production snapshot.
Code review comments should cite the file and line and propose a concrete fix rather than only pointing out a problem.
Before merging a pull request, the change needs one approving review and a green CI run on the latest commit.
Logs are shipped to Loki with a 14-day retention; older logs are only in the cold archive and take a day to restore.
Rate limiting errors (HTTP 429) from the maps API were solved by caching geocoding results for 7 days.
